oneOf.description: A minimal geometric representation defining the axis-aligned or oriented bounding volume of a 3D object.
Geometry-based Point Cloud Compression — an ISO/MPEG standard for compressing static 3D point clouds.
Wavefront OBJ — a widely adopted static mesh format storing vertices, faces, normals, and UVs; ideal for geometry interchange.
Universal Scene Description — Pixar’s extensible 3D scene format supporting static meshes, materials, and large-scale scenes.
STereoLithography format — a simple, universal triangulated-surface format commonly used for 3D printing and static geometry.
Polygon File Format (PLY) — a mesh/point-cloud format used for 3D scanning and static geometry, supporting vertex colors and attributes.
glTF — an efficient, open Khronos static 3D model format optimized for web and real-time engines, supporting PBR materials.
Binary glTF (GLB) — a single-file binary packaging of glTF containing geometry, materials, and textures for optimized delivery.
Filmbox (FBX) — Autodesk’s widely supported 3D exchange format capable of storing static meshes and complete scenes.
USDZ — a compressed, packageable variant of USD designed by Apple and Pixar, widely used for static AR and 3D visualization.
